children: Motilal Oswal's research report on HDFC Life Insurance

HDFC Life Insurance (HDFCLIFE) reported APE of INR47.3b (in line) in 2QFY27, up 13% YoY, with individual APE growing 11% YoY and group APE growing 25% YoY. For 1HFY27, APE grew 11% YoY. Absolute VNB grew 15% YoY to INR11.6b (in line). VNB margins came in at 24.5% vs. 24.1% in 2QFY26 (est. 24.3%). For 1HFY27, VNB grew 12% YoY with VNB margin at 24.7% (24.5% in 1HFY26). Shareholder PAT increased 14% YoY to INR5.1b (in line). Embedded value as of 1HFY27 end was INR664.6b with operating RoEV of 14.9%. VNB margin would continue to benefit from scale and operating leverage, supported by recovery in business volumes; however, much of the upside is likely to be reinvested into capability enhancement.
We have largely maintained our estimates considering the in-line performance in 2QFY27. We reiterate our BUY rating with a TP of INR680 (based on 1.8x FY28E EV).
